head: Grandeur Link puts your Mac's screen, keyboard and trackpad on your iPhone
dek: Grandeur Link shows your Mac's screen on your iPhone and lets you control it with a trackpad and keyboard over your home network. It was #52 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: On the iPhone Duo, half-folding the phone turns it into a small laptop-style workspace. It can also play your Mac's sound and use the iPhone's camera and microphone in meeting apps. It needs a free companion app on an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 13, both on the same network, and iOS 26. It costs $9.99 with no in-app purchases, by Grandeur Co.
means: You can reach your Mac from the couch or another room without a separate remote app subscription.
todo: Install the free Mac companion from grandeurlink.com/mac, then pair your iPhone with the code.
